release_notes:
Responsive order history, mobile card view, and header/statement polish

IMEI order history: desktop uses proportional percentage columns that scale with the container instead of the service column starving; below 992px it becomes a card per order (service name, status, and a + opening the order-details popup) like the dashboard list. Dropped the unnecessary bold on the order-history service and statement IMEI columns. The mobile user pill now shows the customer's name and balance next to the avatar rather than collapsing to the avatar alone, restoring their display over blue.css's .nav-user span hide.
